title: GTA 6 Preloading Causes Major Download Traffic Spikes in Europe
description: ISPs across Europe report major internet traffic spikes following the rollout of GTA 6 preloading on the PlayStation Store for PS5 owners.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Preloading Causes Major Download Traffic Spikes in Europe

If you needed another clue as to how massive GTA 6 is going to be, internet service providers in a number of countries are reporting inflated traffic figures in the wake of preload access.

Millions of eager fans have pre-ordered the open world action title on the PS Store — in fact, it stands as the most pre-ordered game on the digital storefront ever. Ahead of its official launch, these players are able to download the game directly to their PS5s to ensure everything is ready to roll come 19th November.

## A Testament to Record-Breaking Anticipation

Modern blockbuster games require massive file sizes, and Rockstar Games' upcoming title is no exception. With millions of players hitting the download servers simultaneously across Europe, local ISPs have noticed a clear surge in network bandwidth usage. This digital rush highlights the unprecedented scale of the player base and the immense logistical feat of delivering such a massive open-world experience to consoles worldwide ahead of day one.

## Editor's Take

Traffic spikes driven by a single game's preloads are rare, proving that GTA 6 operates on a completely different scale. As millions of PS5 owners ready their systems for November 19th, this digital wave is a clear reminder of the unprecedented excitement surrounding the release.
